insight: Raised $10M (Owl Ventures, Google for Startups AI Academy); CEO Esan Durrani is a Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree.
name: StudyFetch
tagline: Turn your course materials into AI flashcards, quizzes, and a tutor.
description: A study platform that ingests a student's own materials — PDFs, slides, notes, audio, and video — and turns them into flashcards, quizzes, and summaries. Its Spark.E tutor is trained on those uploads to answer questions, generate practice tests, and explain concepts over chat or voice. A free tier offers limited chats and uploads, with paid tiers unlocking unlimited use and a live lecture assistant.
edge: Its Spark.E tutor is grounded only in your uploaded materials — answers from your syllabus, not the open web.
cons: Free tier caps chats and uploads
Answer quality bound by upload quality
